arguments.summary: Investigated the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to the pgbouncer connection pool refresh, not the deploy. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, so I have exported the failed_jobs table using pg_dump as requested. The next step is to review the connection pool configuration changes during the refresh and address any issues in the backlog.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the pgbouncer connection pool configuration to ensure optimal performance. Start addressing the failed-jobs backlog and investigate the root causes of the failures.
